title: Between A Rock And A Hard Place
section_path: Between A Rock And A Hard Place
section_path_text: Between A Rock And A Hard Place
summary:
OPEC(+) decisions becoming more difficult and less impactful
This Sunday, June 2, the group of oil producing countries (OPEC+) will convene to discuss production volumes of the cartel going forward. As always, the meeting (via video conference, not in person) has three possible outcomes: further production cuts, maintaining the status quo or lifting output. While the tanker market, in particular the VLCC segment, would welcome a production increase, a decision to maintain the current production levels seems more likely.
